title: Bea Millan-Windorski's best looks for Miss Universe 2026
summary: From the lush rice terraces of the Cordilleras to the colorful vintas of Mindanao, Bea Millan-Windorski has been bringing different facets of Filipino culture and heritage to the international stage…

blocks.text: From the lush rice terraces of the Cordilleras to the colorful vintas of Mindanao, Bea Millan-Windorski has been bringing different facets of Filipino culture and heritage to the international stage through her outfits at the 2026 Miss Universe pageant in Puerto Rico. The Philippines’ representative has been wearing creations inspired by the country’s landscapes, traditional craftsmanship, historical figures, and local communities as she takes part in the pageant’s activities ahead of the coronation night on Tuesday, Nov. 24 (Wednesday, Nov. 25, in the Philippines).
